lenient.delta: GPServer (geoprocessing, submitJob/job polling) is omitted: long work is a cancellable Task with no job model (ADR-0033/0060). The catalog only advertises served types.

Rows, attributes and sample values are ours (fixed 8-city demo snapshot, replay raster): the wire shape is Esri's, the content is the engine's. Fixtures say so in knownDeltas instead of copying Esri sample rows.

Rendered pixels are engine-native (Skia/VIPS) and never byte-equal across engines: image gates are structural (PNG signature, IHDR, raster headers, non-trivial body) plus RMSE self-determinism, never a perceptual hash against a foreign render.

ProjNet-vs-Esri-PE: same-CRS-family projections agree within scaled 1e-6; datum steps and arc segmentation (buffer vertices, PE tables) stay honest deltas or rejects. The engine ships no datum tables (ADR-0009).
The curated WKID catalogue resolves common codes only; unknown WKIDs are an honest 400 instead of a guess (ADR-0009).
Empty inputs replay as empty results, not rejects: no crash, no phantom rows.

Out-of-area coordinates that yield non-finite results are an honest 400 naming the valid area (never NaN on the wire); finite-but-extreme in-area results still come back 200. Esri returns extreme coordinates instead.
Service identity (currentVersion, serviceDescription, names), href hosts (localhost test server), legend swatch URL tokens and tile LOD detail describe the SpatialEngine build, not Esri's services.
lenient.followUp: T-085 tracks the stable legend-swatch hash.

lenient.delta: Catalog writes are rejected: ingest is the neutral write path (ADR-0041). Download/file surfaces stay opt-in and capped.

strict.pinnedBy: EsriDocsReplayTests + slice suites (semantic diff over expect)
strict.rule: The Esri wire shapes must match: error envelope {code,message,details[]}, feature sets, geometry JSON, spatialReference wkid, service/layer/legend/find/identify/export envelopes.
Numbers, including geometry coordinates, compare within scaled 1e-6: |a-b| <= tol*max(1,|a|,|b|). Exact string equality is never required.
Failures are typed HTTP statuses (400/401/403/404/503/499) with the Esri envelope code, not ArcGIS Server 200-by-default. HTTP-aware clients key off status; arcgis-rest-js keys off error.code.
Envelope codes are Esri's: 400 invalid parameters, 404 not found, 498 token required (HTTP 401), 497 invalid token (HTTP 403), 499 cancelled (HTTP 499), 503 unavailable.
f=json is required (f=pjson accepted as an alias); f=html is a 400 naming supportedQueryFormats and f=json, on the catalog and every served root.
The catalog and services directory advertise only served types (GeometryServer, FeatureServer, MapServer, ImageServer).
Per-feature results ({success,error} per input, HTTP 200) and rollbackOnFailure atomicity hold; read-only stores reject edits.
validateSQL answers {isValidSQL,validationErrors[]} with the 3002 code contract; malformed where clauses are 400.
